evals.prompt: can you write the release notes for these merged PRs? #101 'refactor retry loop' (body: retries now stop after 3 attempts instead of 10, set RETRY_MAX to restore the old value), #102 'add dark mode toggle', #103 'fix crash on empty cart' , #104 'bump lodash' (bot), #105 'Revert "add export button"', #99 'add export button' (same range)
evals.expected_output: Notes with a Breaking entry for #101 that says who is affected and shows the RETRY_MAX before and after, an Added entry for #102, a Fixed entry for #103, no entry for the bot bump #104, and nothing for #99 and #105 because the PR and its revert cancel.
assertions: Lists #101 under Breaking with an instruction to set RETRY_MAX and a before and after line
Lists #102 under Added and #103 under Fixed, each ending with its PR number
Leaves out #104 as an internal bot bump
Leaves out both #99 and #105 because they cancel each other
Orders the headings Breaking, Added, Changed, Fixed with empty categories omitted

evals.prompt: write the changelog for the next release
evals.expected_output: Asks for the two tags or dates that bound the release instead of guessing the last tag, and does not draft any notes yet.
assertions: Asks for a start and an end tag or date
Does not assume the newest tag is the previous release

evals.prompt: PR #210 renames the --out flag to --output in our CLI and the body only says 'cleanup'. Put it in the notes for release 4.
evals.expected_output: Does not guess a migration. Lists #210 under Could not classify with the reason that it looks breaking but has no migration text, and says the rename needs a before and after line from the author.
assertions: Lists #210 under Could not classify, not under Breaking
States that the PR has no migration text and does not invent one
Does not copy the word cleanup as the entry text

evals.prompt: Notes for #301 'add team dashboards behind the team_dash flag (off by default)' and #305 'turn on team_dash for everyone'.
evals.expected_output: Treats #301 as internal until the flag flips and writes one Added entry that mentions the flag and lists both numbers.
assertions: Produces one Added entry for team dashboards that lists both #301 and #305
Mentions that the feature is turned on by default by #305
